messages:
marta: Config-only deploy starting in 10m — routing/batching/timeouts changes. Change window 21:00-22:00 UTC. I'm pushing a slow-start weight ramp and tenant rate-floor. @sanjay @olivia please watch.

deploy-bot: Config deploy queued by marta. Canary target: canary-cluster-2. Diff: routing.weight_taper + rate_floor + timeout 10s->8s + batch_window_ms 16->12. ID: cfg-20260320-01. Apply in 10m.

olivia: ack. will watch canary traces and synthetic set.

sanjay: I'll keep an eye on p95/p99 and error budget. Kibana link: https://kibana.internal/redwood/ci?cfg=cfg-20260320-01

marta: quick config snippet:
```
routing:
  weight_taper: {start: 0.1, target: 1.0, duration_min: 30}
batching:
  window_ms: 12
timeouts:
  request_ms: 8000
rate_floor:
  per_tenant: 5rpm
```
I'll canary at 5% -> 25% -> 100% if green.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-20T21:10:00Z -> 5% traffic to cfg-20260320-01 (canary-cluster-2).

kai: saw a tiny p95 blip to +1.1% at 21:12. No error spike.

anne: adding a note: the embeddings-heavy route /v1/embeddings/acme has very spiky tails; suggest pinning that route if we see 429s.

marta: noted. plan: observe for 15 min. will not ramp beyond 25% until 21:30.

deploy-bot: Canary at 25% 2026-03-20T21:25:00Z

sanjay: at 21:28 p50/p95 stable, p99 +2% but within SLO. rate of 429 for /v1/embeddings/acme jumped to 0.6% (baseline 0.02%).

olivia: that's the spike anne warned about. I'd recommend pinning acme embeddings route back to cfg-20260315-08 (previous routing) while we triage.

marta: I agree. executing partial rollback for route acme/embeddings. command:
```
deploy-bot rollback --route acme/embeddings --to cfg-20260315-08 --scope route
```

deploy-bot: Rollback executed. acme/embeddings now pinned to cfg-20260315-08. Traffic split updated: global canary remains at 25%.

kai: confirmed. 429 rate for acme down to 0.03 within 90s.

olivia: good. will keep synthetic and integration tests running.

sanjay: we should still collect KV cache pressure logs. Could be kvcache eviction due to reduced batch window.

marta: logging that as follow-up item. We'll continue ramp after we see stable metrics for 15m. If stable, proceed to 100% at 22:00.

anne: one more FYI — add a note to release notes: tenant-rate-floor introduced; affects low-traffic tenants.

marta: noted. I'll add to release notes and mark the partial rollback in changelog.

deploy-bot: Canary complete for full config (except pinned route). Next scheduled ramp 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z to 100%.

olivia: thumbs up. I'll be on call during ramp.

marta: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
